scope: Read-only UH03 original-backed bridge diagnosis. No product implementation or new financial acceptance.

kraken.format: 16 columns; txid/refid are native exchange ledger references; no network/destination/on-chain transaction field.

bitpanda.format: 18-column header plus supported 17-field rows; Transaction ID is native exchange identity, not verified chain locator.

ledger.format: 12 columns; Operation Hash and account identity cannot establish which exchange withdrawal caused an incoming event.

checked.otherMaterials: Targeted existing Library searches; found app screenshots and migrated v3 backups do not supply the binding. Parsed 2024/2025 tax reports provide no observed chain-hash linkage; their ownership assumptions are not independent event proof.

privateReproduction.result: PASS structural counts and exact identifier intersection checks; not a financial oracle.
privateReproduction.identity: Original Library identities retained; previous original locators remain valid.

finding: No verified exchange->chain binding was found in the inspected material. Zero exact ID intersections or hash-shaped IDs alone neither prove universal absence nor authorize amount/time inference.
requiredInput: One completed native Kraken or Bitpanda withdrawal detail linking the export exchange reference to network, actual chain transaction hash/signature, destination, asset and amount, with separately stated fees. For a first concrete case use the sole BTC withdrawal in the supplied Kraken original; exact date/amount remain private.
next: Validate the supplied exchange proof against own Ledger account and exact chain event/output; then build one bounded bridge using existing journal/wallet identities without adding already reflected quantities. Distinguish exchange fee and network fee; missing fee split/end balances stay unknown. Independently test both source orders, reimport, encrypted restore, reload/offline/CAS and removal with remaining evidence.
